ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) regions across the medial fluke body with concentrated high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at the distal tips and along surface grooves.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white patches located at the far left and far right distal tips. Parallel, curvilinear high-intensity bands (striations) mapping across the right lobe surface from the mid-section to the trailing edge. Sparse white mottling along the bottom-left margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal pixel angle of 60-70 degrees and significant depth relative to the adjacent lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edges of both lobes; frequency is higher and amplitude is more pronounced on the right lobe margin compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distal lobe tips exhibit convex curvature, transitioning into a moderate concave sweep as the contour approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast circular white pixel clusters detected along the lower-left ventral edge and scattered within the dark field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel curvilinear high-intensity lines (rake marks) that disrupt the dark pigmentation on the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on the right lobe surface; irregular jagged trailing edge suggests potential past mechanical wear or minor predation interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-intensity white pigmentation bordering the trailing edge of the right lobe, creating a high-contrast 'fringe' effect.
